name: openlara
title: OpenLara
description: OpenLara, the open Tomb Raider 1 engine, as a PAX: software renderer at 320x240 (shown 2x or 2.5x) or 320x200 on the 640x400 canvas, sound, gamepad and USB keyboard. Work in progress. Needs your own Tomb Raider 1 PC data (the DATA folder with the .PHD levels) in /sd/roms/openlara/.
author: XProger (OpenLara); ESP32-P4 port by alexkid77
license: BSD-2-Clause (OpenLara); P4 port has no licence yet
about: OpenLara, the open-source Tomb Raider 1 engine, with the software renderer from alexkid77's ESP32-P4 port (320x240 RGB565, scaled 2x to 640x480 or 2.5x to 800x600; on the 640x400 canvas it renders a 16:10 320x200 view, scaled 2x), 44.1 kHz sound, the loader's gamepad and USB keyboard. Copy the DATA folder of your own Tomb Raider 1 PC game (GYM.PHD, LEVEL1.PHD, ..., TITLE.PHD and the .PCX pictures) to /sd/roms/openlara/; optional FMV/ movies and music tracks go next to it. Settings and saves are written to the same folder.
controls: D-pad: move / turn; choose items in the inventory
A: action (grab, pick up, use); select in menus
X (hold): walk; walk + left/right: side step
Menu (hold 3 s) or the on-screen X: quit
Keyboard: X = B, C = X, V/Tab = Y, Q = L, E = R
Keyboard: Esc inventory, Ctrl action, Alt jump
Keyboard: 5 quick save, 9 quick load, F12 FPS

requires.note: Tomb Raider 1 PC levels: copy the game's DATA folder

extract.instructions:
Provide the complete matching data set from your original installation or the verified download choice below. Keep filenames and subfolders as listed.

FILES / FOLDERS

/sd/roms/openlara/DATA/*.PHD — Tomb Raider 1 PC levels: copy the game's DATA folder

/sd/roms/openlara/FMV/ — The game's movies
